title: सूरज ढलते ही क्यों गायब हो जाती है गाँव की परछाइयाँ?
topic: एक अनोखा गाँव जहाँ शाम होते ही लोगों की परछाइयाँ गायब होकर एक जादुई पेड़ पर लटक जाती हैं
description: सोचिए अगर शाम ढलते ही आपकी परछਾਈ आपको छोड़कर भाग जाए तो क्या होगा? जानिए इस रोमांचक और सीख भरी कहानी में। #कहानीपतंग #JaadiKahani #KidsStories #MagicTree #HindiStories

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: सोचिए... अगर सूरज ढलते ही आपकी परछाई अचानक आपको छोड़कर दीवार पर भागने लगे, तो क्या होगा?
scenes.style: warm, gentle storyteller, building sudden eerie curiosity
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Indian boy Chintu, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue cotton shorts, barefoot, Indian look, standing in a dusty village courtyard at sunset, looking at a wall in shock, wide shot, warm orange lighting.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: यही हुआ नन्हे चिंटू के साथ! शाम के ठीक छह बजे... उसकी परछाई उसके पैरों से अलग हो गई!
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Indian boy Chintu, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue cotton shorts, barefoot, Indian look, looking down at his feet with empty ground, twilight, medium shot, dramatic shadows.

scenes.speaker: C
scenes.text: अरे! मेरी परछाई... मेरी परछाई मेरे साथ क्यों नहीं चल रही?
scenes.style: panicked, high pitched childish voice, trembling
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Indian boy Chintu, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue cotton shorts, barefoot, Indian look, waving hands in panic in a village lane, dusk, close-up shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: अब ध्यान से सुनिए... वह परछाई सीधे गाँव के उस पुराने बरगद के पेड़ की तरफ भागी, जहाँ कोई नहीं जाता!
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Indian boy Chintu, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue cotton shorts, barefoot, Indian look, pointing finger towards a giant ancient banyan tree in the distance, night approaching, wide shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: क्या आप अंदाज़ा लगा सकते हैं कि बरगद के पेड़ पर ऐसा क्या था? चलिए, राज से पर्दा उठाते हैं।
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Indian boy Chintu, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue cotton shorts, barefoot, Indian look, walking cautiously towards a shadowy tree, evening, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: चिंटू ने हिम्मत जुटाई और धीरे-धीरे उस विशाल बरगद के पेड़ के पास पहुँच गया।
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Indian boy Chintu, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue cotton shorts, barefoot, Indian look, hiding behind a thick root of the banyan tree, night, low angle medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: पेड़ की शाखाओं पर कोई भूत नहीं था... बल्कि वहाँ गाँव के सभी लोगों की परछाइयाँ लटकी हुई थीं!
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Indian boy Chintu, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue cotton shorts, barefoot, Indian look, staring wide-eyed at tree branches glowing with human-shaped shadows, night, wide shot.

scenes.speaker: C
scenes.text: ओह! ये तो मेरे मोहल्ले वाले चाचा-चाची की परछाइयाँ हैं! वे सब यहाँ क्या कर रही हैं?
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Indian boy Chintu, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue cotton shorts, barefoot, Indian look, looking up at the glowing hanging shadows, night, close-up shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: आप होते तो क्या करते? क्या आप उस डरावने पेड़ पर चढ़ते या वापस भाग जाते?
scenes.style: direct question to viewer, playful yet engaging
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Indian boy Chintu, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue cotton shorts, barefoot, Indian look, scratching his head in deep thought under the magic tree, night, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: चिंटू भागा नहीं! उसने एक परछाई से पूछा कि वे रोज़ शाम को यहाँ क्यों आ जाती हैं।
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Indian boy Chintu, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue cotton shorts, barefoot, Indian look, talking politely to a glowing shadow on a low branch, night, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: और तब परछाई ने जो राज खोला, उसे सुनकर चिंटू की आँखें फटी की फटी रह गईं!
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Indian boy Chintu, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue cotton shorts, barefoot, Indian look, gasping with wide open mouth, night, close-up shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: परछाई बोली—'हम बोर हो जाती हैं दिनभर एक ही इंसान के पीछे चलते-चलते! इसलिए शाम को यहाँ आकर थोड़ी मस्ती करती हैं।'
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Indian boy Chintu, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue cotton shorts, barefoot, Indian look, laughing happily while shadows dance around him on the tree, night, wide shot.

scenes.speaker: C
scenes.text: अच्छा! तो बात यह है? पर मेरी परछाई को तो मेरे साथ सोना पसंद है, है ना?
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Indian boy Chintu, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue cotton shorts, barefoot, Indian look, smiling warmly as his own shadow jumps back to his feet, night, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: चिंटू की समझदारी से परछाई मान गई और वापस उसके पैरों से चिपक गई।
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Indian boy Chintu, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue cotton shorts, barefoot, Indian look, walking back home happily with his shadow neatly attached, moonlight, wide shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: इस जादुई रात ने सिखाया कि हर रहस्य डरावना नहीं होता, कभी-कभी वे सिर्फ मस्ती के लिए होते हैं!
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Indian boy Chintu, round cheerful face, big black curious eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue cotton shorts, barefoot, Indian look, waving goodbye to the glowing banyan tree with a smile, night, cinematic wide shot.
